_note: Canonical translations for informal law nicknames used in the tools. Rule: (1) nicknames listed here always use exactly these translations; in the law's own language use its official name, otherwise a short descriptive name followed by the jurisdiction in parentheses. (2) Citations made of an official code or number (EU AI Act Art. 50, GDPR, LGPD, California SB 942, NYC LL 144) stay exactly as written in English. (3) A jurisdiction named on its own is translated normally. tests/i18n-law-names.test.js enforces rule 1.
